name: Palisade
description: It was set down to mark where one field ended and the next began, and then the fence moved and nobody told it. Palisade still walks the old line exactly — the same corner, the same twelve paces, the same slight bend around a tree that is no longer there. It is very precise about a boundary that stopped existing some years ago, and it has never once been late.
babyDescription: A small blank case with nothing to mark yet, waiting to be set down somewhere.
teenDescription: The posts are up along its back and the lamp is lit. Counts its own paces, and corrects itself near the corner every time.
adultDescription: A walking fence keeping a line the field forgot, to the pace.
